ops.text: Commit 9c1cecb added com.apple.bluetoothd to debloat.bluebubbles (to kill the airportd CoreWLAN storm), but coreaudiod's Bluetooth HAL plugin and audiomxd retry their bluetoothd-provided XPC services (com.apple.BTAudioHALPlugin.xpc, com.apple.bluetooth.xpc) in a tight no-backoff loop when the service is absent: one coreaudiod thread spun at ~40% for its entire life, two launchd threads burned ~37% each servicing the lookup flood (launchd alone accumulated 323 CPU-hours = 0.72 cores avg since boot), totaling ~1.7 cores host-side for 18.7 days. Metal does not debloat bluetoothd and shows no such burn. Verified by live A/B: launchctl disable+bootout of com.apple.audio.coreaudiod + com.apple.audiomxd dropped launchd from ~70% to 0.5% (0.2 CPU-sec over a 37s window) and the host-side VM process from 184% to 8.7%, with BlueBubbles health unaffected (ping ok, helper_connected=True). Residual: ~9 GUI/media clients (ControlCenter, avconferenced, corespeechd, mediaremoted, callservicesd, etc.) now poll com.apple.audio.audiohald at ~1/s each — timer-paced, CPU-negligible. Live mitigation is persistent in this guest (launchctl disable survives reboot) but not yet codified in machines.json debloat.bluebubbles.system.
